Your Phone's Secret Energy Kitchen!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Every smartphone battery is a miniature chemical kitchen.
🔹 Special charged particles (ions) shuffle back and forth.
🔹 Using your phone moves ions one way, releasing energy.
🔹 Charging reverses the flow, storing energy for later.
🔹 This silent 'cooking' continuously powers your digital life.
